- Overweight bullish sentiment in recent days when forecast spikes occur — model tends to overshoot after strong positive sentiment.
- Underweight bearish sentiment when sentiment is low but price is trending up — model often fails to adjust downward early.
- Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment spikes — model frequently overcorrects or undercorrects based on sentiment without sufficient lag.
- Mean-reversion bias: model tends to overcorrect toward historical mean after sharp moves, especially after sentiment shifts.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are overly optimistic in early periods (e.g., 2025-10-06) when sentiment is mixed; adjust downward if sentiment is neutral or slightly bearish.
- Lagged sentiment influence: model reacts to sentiment 1–2 days too late — incorporate sentiment from 3–5 days prior for better alignment with true price behavior.
